titel: Introducing Sound Detectives from LeVar Burton

einzeiler: A funny and engaging podcast about missing sounds and an unusual detective duo.
kurzfassung: Sounds are mysteriously disappearing across the globe, throwing the world into chaos. LeVar Burton recruits private investigator Detective Hunch to find the culprit known as the Sound Swindler. Together with a giant walking human ear named Audie, Hunch must identify and return the missing sounds to save the world from silence.
stichpunkte: Sounds vanish globally, including animal noises, vehicle horns, and everyday household sounds.
A mysterious villain dubbed the Sound Swindler is blamed for the worldwide silence.
LeVar Burton enlists private eye Detective Hunch to solve the case for his upcoming Museum of Sound.
LeVar provides Hunch with a box containing several unidentified missing sounds to start the investigation.
LeVar assigns his trusted companion, Audie the Ear, to assist Hunch on the mission.
Audie turns out to be a three-foot-five-inch walking, talking human ear with arms and legs.

clips.text: News reports reveal that animals across the country have stopped making their signature noises.

clips.hook: Decorated and honored in how many countries?
clips.text: LeVar highlights the detective's impressive international reputation while getting corrected on the exact number of countries.

clips.hook: How do you put sounds in a box?
clips.text: The detective expresses bewilderment upon discovering that several missing items are physically stored right in his office.

beschreibung:
LeVar Burton presents SOUND DETECTIVES – a funny, engaging, and thought-provoking podcast that invites elementary school-aged kids to explore the magic and mystery of sound.
Breaking News – Across the globe, sounds are mysteriously going missing! Waves aren’t crashing, crickets aren’t chirping, and the familiar jingle of the ice cream truck is a distant memory. Follow Detective Hunch (Vinny Thomas) and his new sidekick Audie the Ear (Jess McKenna) as they solve sound mysteries and track down the nefarious Sound Swindler … all with a little help from LeVar Burton himself!
Equal parts fun and informative, SOUND DETECTIVES encourages listeners to engage with the sound mysteries that surround us, while unlocking the door to people and cultures around the globe. Join the team on this semi-improvised comedy caper and help return the mystery sounds before the world falls silent!
Listen to SOUND DETECTIVES on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you listen to podcasts.
